invitation.unchecked: This is what the link says. Accept only if you expect this invitation and know who sent it.
invitation.password.hint: The password for the account at the invited address, the one you use in your Bitwarden app. It is worked on in this browser and never sent: the server gets only a hash of it.
invitation.wrong: That master password is not right. Check it and try again; too many wrong tries are limited.
invitation.limited: Too many tries. Wait a while before you try again.
invitation.limited.wait: Too many tries. Wait {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} before you try again.
invitation.unavailable: This page could not work out your master password's check here. Try again in a moment, or accept the invitation in your Bitwarden app.
invitation.incomplete: This link is incomplete. Open the one in the email exactly as it was sent.
invitation.refused: The invitation couldn't be accepted. The link may have expired (they last five days) or been used already; ask whoever invited you for a new one.
invitation.organization.title: Invitation to an organization
invitation.organization.done: Invitation accepted. An administrator now confirms you, and then the organization appears in your Bitwarden or Kemlock app. You are not signed in here.
invitation.emergency.title: Invitation as an emergency contact
invitation.emergency.accept: Accept and become their emergency contact
invitation.emergency.done: Invitation accepted. The person who named you now confirms you; nothing opens until you ask for access and the wait they chose has passed. You are not signed in here.
invitation.signup.title: Finish creating your account
invitation.signup.proven: {email} is verified. This page can't set your master password: go back to the app where you started and continue creating the account there.
invitation.signup.next: If the app asks for the verification code from the email, copy it here and paste it in.
